sloka: नाजानाज्जीवतीं रामः स मां लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।जानन्तौ तौ न कुर्यातां नोर्व्यां हि मम मार्गणम् ।। ५.२६.३९।।।।
transliteration: nājānājjīvatīṁ rāmaḥ sa māṁ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।jānantau tau na kuryātāṁ norvyāṁ hi mama mārgaṇam ।। 5.26.39।।।।

translations.english: "Neither Lakshmana nor his elder brother knows that I am here alive. (Had they known) both of them would have ransacked this earth.
